title: Casa Batllo tour
text: Magnificent tour!  The casa design allows you to get an understanding of Gaudi and his brilliant mind. The usage of light, colors and interpretation of nature is beautiful!
author: bethn833

title: Worth the effort!
text: This is a very busy attraction, expect a large crowd! We bought the Gold tickets which allowed us to see additional areas and was worth the money. This house is one of the most fantastic I have ever seen.
author: Justin F

title: Full with colours and creativity 😊
text:
Entrance without waiting, it was perfect.
The audio gide was also perfect, thank You for the lifetime experience. The rooftop bar was the best, very kind staff and hosting.
author: Edina A

title: Fabulous architecture in this home.
text: We really enjoyed touring through the home of the same architect that designed the Sagrada Familia.  Recommend that you get the Blue level ticket with audio guide.  The silver level lets you see some furniture.  The gold level provides an iPad for some virtual reality experience.  I saw others with the iPad and it didn't look very useful.
author: David_K

title: A must see in Barcelona
text:
A must see!!! Excellent audio tour, took basic blue tour and it was enough information for me. 
Did not understand Gaudi’s philosophy until this tour. 
Lots of steps-
author: Stampedetravels

title: You will not be disappointed
text: Well worth this skip the queue experience so easy and smooth. The audio guide is great just enough detail not too much. Love the submersive gaudy experience at the end.  Definately a must see experience in Barcelona.
author: janebO6425IV

title: Good experience
text: I thought that by purchasing a smart phone experience I would be getting that.  Instead I was given a hand held listening device for each area.  Also, we were not able to use the rooftop bar because it was closing even though the Casa was still letting guests in.
author: Lisa_L

title: Impressive is not a big enough superlative.
text: Have always been an admirer of Antoni Gaudi, finally able to experience in person his architecture! It is amazing even from outside. Tried to get tickets to go inside, but for some strange reason they would not allow over 64 year old to purchase! My husband and I are way over!
author: Navigator37201658270
